$comment: The duty a row states, named once across every instrument that states it, so a reader sees one duty from six standards side by side (Demiton UX audit 2026-10-06). An obligation's `duty_shape` is a key here. A key reads `family.duty`, the first two segments of the obligation key that first stated it; rows that state the same duty under another key name this shape instead (NZS 3910's unforeseen conditions notice is `latent_conditions.notice`). Each value is the duty in a contractor's words.
